question: Should this shared provider-usage helper set be accepted as a bundled/local SDK seam after live evidence confirms both existing admin credential formats and provider responses remain unchanged?
rationale: The code is an intentional cross-provider refactor, but only mocked fixture proof is available for behavior that depends on live provider response formats and persisted local admin tokens.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Request redacted Anthropic and OpenAI admin-usage output or logs showing existing credentials and representative paginated responses produce the same snapshots.

options.title: Accept fixture-only refactor risk
options.body: Merge based on exact fixture equality and CI if maintainers accept that live administrative API behavior cannot be demonstrated for this internal refactor.
